item.title: Casper, Laramie BioLife Plasma Services locations permanently close without warning
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. –– The BioLife Plasma Services locations in Casper and Laramie abruptly and permanently closed on Tuesday. Customers of the plasma donation service became aware of the closures after notices were posted on the company’s apps and website.
